article.title: The youth want a future: The Thirty-Ninth Newsletter (2026)
article.author: Vijay Prashad
article.content: Behind widespread youth uprisings lies a stark contradiction: an economic system that protects capital while stripping young people of dignified work, community, and the confidence that tomorrow can be different.
